_comment: Human-readable source of truth for karma weights and jail defaults. IMPORTANT PLATFORM NOTE: Bedrock scripts cannot read arbitrary files at runtime (the same reason telemetry.js writes to stdout instead of a file), so this JSON isn't loaded automatically — packs/moogul_core_bp/scripts/karma.js keeps a matching hardcoded copy of these values as its actual live defaults. When you tune a number, edit it here AND in karma.js's DEFAULT_WEIGHTS/DEFAULT_JAIL consts, OR use the live in-game override: /scriptevent moogul:karmaweight <key> <value> (persists in a dynamic property, takes priority over the hardcoded defaults without needing a restart).

thresholds._comment: Karma bands used only for the deck's display + flavor consequences, never for automatic punishment.

economy._comment: Trades and fines are judge-mediated (you, via the deck) — nothing here moves gold bars automatically.
